title: 第1039章 凌九霄降临第1038章 战场外的风波
slug: 逆天悟性我在修仙界证道长生
content_zh:
蝉噪林逾静，鸟鸣山更幽。
偌大的青天台座无虚席，然而此刻，却陷入了死一般的寂静，连心跳声都清晰可闻。
那些遭遇厄难的仙宗门人，个个如丧考妣，最后一丝侥幸彻底破碎，只剩下无边无际的绝望。
“苍天无眼，以少宗主的惊世才情，加上大成的仙灵神体，未来本该有望问鼎大罗！
怎能...怎能让他死在这种地方?！”
“不——！
誉儿啊！
其实为师才是你的亲生父亲。
本想等这次试炼结束，便当众传位于你....为何会发生这等惨祸？为什么？”
“唉.....造化弄人！
圣子你安心去吧，汝之道侣....吾自会替你细心照料，勿虑也！”
“......”
一时间，哀嚎声、痛哭声、撕心裂肺的咆哮声喧天而起，在青天台上空久久回荡。
此番遭遇万烬生毒手的，无一不是金仙境的绝代天骄，这等惨重损失，对大罗仙宗都足以伤筋动骨，
而那些底蕴稍逊的势力，更是天都塌了下来——近百万年的栽培付之东流，简直是惨不忍睹。
更有甚者，几位血脉相连的至亲长老，当场急火攻心，“噗”
地喷出一口老血，直挺挺地昏死过去。
“太惨了！”
目睹此景，即便是无关的旁观者，也不禁生出兔死狐悲之感，人人自危，生怕厄运下一刻便降临己身。
然而怕什么，偏偏就来什么。

就在一片愁云惨淡之中，悬浮于虚空的岁月年轮镜，陡然掀起一阵涟漪——
飒！
只见榜单前列几个名字，竟如泡沫般褪色剥落，转瞬便从镜面上彻底消失，不留半点痕迹。
“不！
！”
刹那间，人群中爆发出几声凄厉哀嚎，如杜鹃啼血，撕心裂肺，闻者无不动容。
就连稳坐高台的龟翁也霍然变色。
他目光如电，死死锁定战场深处的乌云，眉头拧成川字：“已有百人殒落！
这不对劲！”
往届神战，虽也偶有折损，但大多不过十数人，即便局势最恶劣之时，也仅在二三十人间徘徊。
纵观漫长岁月，唯一一次伤亡破百，还是因一尊大罗境厄兽违逆常理，冲出天柱山禁区，在绝灵深渊掀起滔天血祸。
可眼下.....赛程才刚过半，陨落人数便已直逼那场灭顶之劫！
由此可见，今日的仙古战场内，定然蛰伏着某种远超预料的“大恐怖”
，正在悄然破封！

content_en:
The noisy cicada forest is more than quiet, and the bird singing mountain is even more secluded.
The huge Qingtian Terrace was packed with seats, but at this moment, it fell into a deathly silence, and even the heartbeat could be clearly heard.
Those members of the Immortal Sect who encountered misfortunes felt like they were mourning for their heirs. The last trace of luck was completely shattered, leaving only boundless despair.
"There is no eye in the sky. With the young sect leader's astonishing talent and Dacheng's immortal spirit body, he should be expected to aspire to become the Great Luo in the future!
How could...how could he be allowed to die in a place like this?! "
“No—!
Yu'er!
In fact, your teacher is your biological father.
I wanted to wait until this trial was over and tell everyone about you... Why did such a tragedy happen? Why? "
"Alas... nature plays tricks on people!
Holy Son, go in peace, your Taoist companion... I will take good care of you, don't worry! "
"..."
Suddenly, wails, cries, and heart-rending roars rose up in the sky, echoing over Qingtian Terrace for a long time.
Those who encountered the poisonous hands of Wanjinsheng this time were all the most outstanding geniuses in the Golden Immortal Realm. Such heavy losses were enough to break the bones of Daluo Immortal Sect.
As for those forces with weaker foundations, the sky has fallen even more - nearly a million years of cultivation have been wasted, which is simply terrible.
What's more, several close relatives and elders who were connected by blood were furious on the spot, "poof"
A mouthful of old blood spurted out on the ground, and he passed out straight away.
"What a tragedy!"
Witnessing this scene, even uninvolved bystanders can't help but feel the sadness of the rabbit dying and the fox dying. Everyone is in danger, fearing that bad luck will befall them in the next moment.
However, whatever you are afraid of, it will happen.
In the midst of the gloom and bleakness, the year-ring mirror suspended in the void suddenly caused a wave of ripples——
Sa!
I saw a few names at the top of the list, fading and peeling off like bubbles, disappearing completely from the mirror in an instant, leaving no trace.
"No!
! "
In an instant, several shrill wails erupted from the crowd, like a cuckoo crying for blood, heartbreaking, and moved everyone who heard it.
Even the turtle man who was sitting firmly on the high platform suddenly changed his color.
His eyes were like lightning, fixed on the dark clouds deep in the battlefield, and his brows were furrowed: "Hundreds of people have died!
This is not right! "
Although there were occasional losses in previous divine wars, most of them only had a dozen or so people. Even when the situation was at its worst, there were only twenty or thirty people.
Throughout the long years, the only time the casualties exceeded 100 was because a Da Luo realm evil beast defied common sense and broke out of the restricted area of ​​Tianzhu Mountain, causing a bloody disaster in the Jueling Abyss.
But right now...the schedule has just passed halfway, and the number of people who have died is already approaching that catastrophic disaster!
It can be seen from this that there must be some kind of "great terror" dormant in today's ancient battlefield that is far beyond expectation.
, is quietly breaking the seal!
